name: Hotel-Cancellation-Minimization-Booking-Behavior-Analysis
what_it_holds: Analysis project (SQL + Python + Power BI .pbix) over the same Antonio/Almeida/Nunes-style two-Portugal-property dataset (Lisbon city hotel + Algarve resort hotel, ~100k+ raw records, 86,113 bookings in the final analysed set, Jul 2015–Oct 2017) with cancellation-status, advance-booking-window (lead time), ADR, and booking-channel (TA/TO, Corporate, Direct, GDS) fields. Raw CSV not clearly committed in-repo (analysis outputs and BI file are); described as sourced from Kaggle/ScienceDirect.
why_useful: Confirms the Portugal H1/H2 dataset is the dominant public hotel-cancellation source on GitHub and that its lead-time field is literally named 'window_booking' in some derivative repos — useful only as a pointer to the same data we already hold, not new.
duplicate_of_holding: Portugal hotel-booking demand dataset (Antonio/Almeida/Nunes) already in our holdings
themes: Airbnb cancellation, refund and Reserve-Now-Pay-Later related datasets; STR booking lead-time and cancellation-rate data from any platform or PMS
Hotel booking demand datasets (Antonio Almeida Nunes and successors), hotel PMS datasets, revenue-management datasets with cancellations and lead times
why_all: Confirms the Portugal H1/H2 dataset is the dominant public hotel-cancellation source on GitHub and that its lead-time field is literally named 'window_booking' in some derivative repos — useful only as a pointer to the same data we already hold, not new.

Confirms channel-segmented lead-time and cancellation breakdowns (TA/TO vs Corporate vs Direct vs GDS) on the already-held Antonio data that our own construction may not have replicated; low incremental value as it is a duplicate source, but the channel segmentation could be a useful reference for gap #3 (booking lead time / cancellation-rate distributions).

name: argilla/tripadvisor-hotel-reviews
what_it_holds: 20,500 TripAdvisor hotel reviews (the well-known 'TripAdvisor Hotel Reviews' Kaggle set, mirrored/curated on Hugging Face by Argilla with added sentiment labels 1-5, confidence scores, text length). Reviews span international hotels (Florence, Barcelona, Hawaii, Amsterdam, Paris, Singapore, Punta Cana, Berlin, Tokyo, etc.), dates roughly 2004-2008 in visible samples. Parquet format, loadable via HF `datasets` or pandas.
why_useful: Small but clean, ready-to-load, dated review sample across many geographies; could serve as a spot-check / calibration set for any review-velocity or sentiment method before scaling to HotelRec. Marginal versus HotelRec for size but easier to pull (no gated download).
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps conceptually with Booking.com 515k-review Kaggle set already held, but TripAdvisor source is new

name: magic890/tripadvisor-scraper
what_it_holds: 80-star Scrapy-based scraper targeting TripAdvisor restaurant listings (command shown: `scrapy crawl tripadvisor-restaurant`). Outputs JSON-lines by default. No sample data committed. GPL-3.0 licensed; educational-use disclaimer in README about possible ToS conflicts.
why_useful: Restaurant demand/velocity is a weak but free proxy for local tourism activity (adjacent to OpenTable seated-diner data already held); low direct relevance to ABNB but easy to adapt.
